title: Drought-prone Kutch region
subject: Environment
caption: Map of the drought‑prone Kutch region in Gujarat, India.
altText: A detailed textbook‑style map on a white background showing the Kutch region of Gujarat, India. The map outlines the district’s borders, marks major towns such as Bhuj and Mandvi, displays the Rann of Kutch, and uses a color gradient from light beige to deep orange to indicate areas of increasing drought risk. A legend explains the color coding, and a north arrow and scale bar are included. All geographic features and drought‑risk zones are clearly labelled, providing an accurate visual reference for drought management studies.
